rule: Long 200 SPY shares, each month sell 2 call contracts about 2% OTM, ~30 DTE (next third-Friday expiry), held to expiry.
strike_rule: nearest listed strike to spot*(1+otm) for calls, spot*(1-otm) for puts, spot = underlying close on the roll date

half_spread_per_share.status: ASSUMPTION: bars are trade prices, no historical quotes exist; entry pays/receives this per share

settlement: intrinsic value vs underlying close at expiry; ITM short call = assignment, shares rebought same close
benchmark: buy_and_hold SPY, same shares, same dates
